items.title: [负面] I *REALLY* LOVE THIS GAME, but changes were announ...
items.summary:
I *REALLY* LOVE THIS GAME, but changes were announced that I just could not get behind and I'll change my review the moment the devs change their minds about it.

D-Zone, the "endgame" mode of the game, was amazing and really fun. It didnt allow shortcuts, gave really good rewards, had varying difficulties for newer accounts to get left behind and, due to the fact that was all there was to it, the experiences between players were largely similar, allowing people that struggled to see people just as strong as them or even weaker extract wildly different results, shining a beautiful light in the game's very good game design and how almost every character could be used and do amazing.

It was announced that, due to whales and people that have spent thousands of hours of the game (way less than the 1% of the community) could, due to all they amassed not only in terms of acquisition but also knowledge and experience, finish some of the hardest fights in one turn (WOW, HIGH INVESTMENT BEING REWARDED?!), so now the devs think that the challenge is not good enough and now they will make nightmare modes and, to not leave the PLEBS behind, allow people to "use shortcuts" such as "second lives" mid combat in case they wipe (be restored to full immediately).

Whale exclusive content (if you dont "cheat"), shortcuts to trivialize easier stuff, fragment the community by making their experiences less alike due to the fact that some may not choose to use the revive and some play in wildly different difficulties... Is that it?

Hopefully we see better judgement on their part before any of this makes into the game... Please don't smear this feces on such a great game.

items.title: [负面] Honestly this game's a bit hard to rate for me; I...
items.summary:
Honestly this game's a bit hard to rate for me; I love the gameplay and mechanics, the Gacha aspect is generous [i] (I've managed to get most of the characters I like/need) [/i], and the story is decent. I would talk about all this, but I'd like to harp on my issues.

Character designs are where it falls apart a bit for me; no/few dark-skinned characters. Those who do exist [i] (who I am defining as Wanda, Thais and Goliath) [/i], from what I've seen, are in a little bit of bad taste [i] (at the time of writing I am halfway through chapter 7, where Thais appears) [/i]. Now, is it as bad as Genshin white-washing the cultures entirely? Of course not, but that's an absurdly low bar to clear.

The automatic/AI translation does suck, but the story doesn't suffer too much in my opinion, just the descriptions of some cards/relics that are iffy.

As for the more recent updates that are planned [b] please refer to other recent negative reviews [/b]. I'm not far enough into progression to make any assertions but as it sounds late-game content will be getting worse in the near future and the game will become more pay to win.

Overall it's a fun game suffering from the same issues as 99% of gacha games, just less chronically. I hate that this game has these issues as it has a strong gameplay loop.

[i] P.S. I will return to edit this review if any of these points become void (either via an update or me exploring more of the game) OR these points gets worse, and I want to further detail them. I do apologise if some of them ARE null from later content that I haven't accessed, I just wanted to express my current opinions. And yes, I wouldn't necessarily recommend the game. [/i]
